Hattiesburg MS pottery studio open studi.snippet: Soda firing involves the introduction of sodium sources such as soda ash (carbonate), soda bicarbonate, and borax into the kiln environment starting at cone 8. The soda combines with the silica, alumina, iron, and other elements in the surface of the wares to produce a glazed or flashed surface.

Hattiesburg MS pottery studio open studi.snippet: In addition to our two wood kilns, our Cone 10 reduction gas kiln is also fired with great frequency. It is the primary kiln for student work, though students have access to the wood kilns as well. We have over 40 glazes to choose from, all of which do spectacularly in the gas kiln. Cone 10 reduction firing allows us to achieve rich colors and a wide range of surface finishes.
